title: Emergency visit: throbbing pain on a lower molar

transcript.speaker: PATIENT
transcript.text: My lower right back tooth has been throbbing for three days, it keeps me up at night.

transcript.speaker: PATIENT
transcript.text: I've been taking ibuprofen, like four hundred milligrams every few hours.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Let's get a periapical x-ray of that area.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Cold test on thirty is lingering, it hurts for a long time after. Percussion is positive on thirty.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Thirty has deep decay on the distal reaching the pulp. This is irreversible pulpitis.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: I'd recommend a root canal on thirty and then a crown. We can start the root canal next week.
